reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
)
SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN order_eur > 1000 THEN order_eur ELSE 0 END) / SUM(order_eur) AS big_order_share
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY channel
alternatives: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, channel) SELECT channel, COALESCE(SUM(order_eur) FILTER (WHERE order_eur > 1000), 0) / SUM(order_eur) AS big_order_share FROM order_totals GROUP BY channel

WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, channel), big AS (SELECT channel, SUM(order_eur) AS big_eur FROM order_totals WHERE order_eur > 1000 GROUP BY channel), all_orders AS (SELECT channel, SUM(order_eur) AS total_eur FROM order_totals GROUP BY channel) SELECT a.channel, COALESCE(b.big_eur, 0) / a.total_eur AS big_order_share FROM all_orders a LEFT JOIN big b ON b.channel = a.channel

other_way.sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur FROM sales GROUP BY order_id, channel), big AS (SELECT channel, SUM(order_eur) AS big_eur FROM order_totals WHERE order_eur > 1000 GROUP BY channel), all_orders AS (SELECT channel, SUM(order_eur) AS total_eur FROM order_totals GROUP BY channel) SELECT a.channel, COALESCE(b.big_eur, 0) / a.total_eur AS big_order_share FROM all_orders a LEFT JOIN big b ON b.channel = a.channel
other_way.tradeoff: Two named totals read step by step, but the big total needs a LEFT JOIN and COALESCE so a channel with no big order keeps its row.
